turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Ms. Kalinowski sets her bag on the nearest desk and stays standing. "I have until 4:40. The zero goes in the gradebook, my son finds out on his phone in front of his class, and I get no call. Explain that."
"You asked for this meeting, Hale. I asked a question. Who decided to enter that zero, and was Owen spoken to first?"
Owen is a great kid. Really bright, one of my favourites.
"Don't manage me. I asked who decided, and I'd like an answer before the next compliment."
I'm sure this is all just a misunderstanding.
"'Just a misunderstanding.' Okay. Then you'll have no trouble telling me who entered the zero, and when."
So can we agree he's a good student?
"I'm not agreeing to anything until I've seen what you're holding. You entered a zero, so you have a reason, and I'm waiting to hear it."
